text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq calls for lifting of ban on its oil exports this year.
- Moslems in Britain denounce crimes perpetrated by U.N. arms inspection teams in Iraq.
- Ship loaded with wheat arrives at Umm Qasr.
- Iraq protests against violation by U.S. and allied planes of its air space.
- Confrontation with Zionist enemy (in West Bank) leads to martyrdom of a Palestinian and wounding of many others.
- Jordanian newspaper criticises presence of U.S. troops in region.
- National Assembly Speaker Saadoun Hammadi lauds Russian stand vis-a-vis Iraq.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Commentary on need to improve Iraqi-Turkish relations.
- Article on failure of U.S. conspiracies against Iraq.
